derivation: Trust scores derived from on-chain USDC payment flows on Base mainnet. score:null for unobserved services is intentional (no signal != bad signal).
verification_recipe: 3. Check score matches expected (null or within range)
4. Check tier and recommendation match expected values
6. Check canon_version in JWS claims equals jcs-rfc8785-v1

vectors.name: known-service-scored
vectors.description: Service with observed x402 payment history returns real trust score
vectors.pair_note: Positive case: service with 70K+ calls and 231 payers

vectors.name: unknown-service-null
vectors.description: Service without observed x402 payment activity returns null score
vectors.pair_note: Negative case: explicit null, not a default score

vectors.name: timestamp-ms-canonicalization
vectors.description: JWS attestation uses timestamp_ms (epoch integer) per shared canonicalization discipline #2326
vectors.jws_claim_check: iat and exp fields MUST be Unix epoch integers, NOT RFC 3339 strings
vectors.pair_note: Validates alignment with privacy_class v0.1 vector 007a timestamp convention

vectors.name: null-score-not-default
vectors.description: score:null is semantically distinct from score:0 or score:50
vectors.pair_note: Prevents soft-erosion: null means no signal, not bad signal

vectors.name: batch-composition
vectors.description: Batch endpoint returns independent scores per query
vectors.pair_note: First query scored, second null -- batch preserves per-query independence
